data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nadjm’ meaning ‘star’. This beautiful name symbolizes the shining light and guidance that a child may bring to her family and community. The name Nedjma carries the meaning “Star, Guiding Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nedjma usually hope their child will grow to embody star, guiding light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nedjma total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
